description: E001 is supported by a partial article body stating over 30 guards, which establishes at least 31 but no upper bound; the required 50-person threshold remains unverified.

description: Physical end dates for E002 and E003 are unknown. E003 is part of a broader justice campaign, but no evidence shows a continuous physical gathering from January or from the 2020 Cuffy Square event.

description: This first pass used 20 captured English-language open-web search actions (584 returned headers) spanning general, outlet, week, labour, education, health, agriculture, mining, police, and region-specific terms. It did not replicate LexisNexis or verify the official month baseline; non-indexed and non-English reporting may be missed.
